description: Defines the abstract class gl::RenderbufferImpl for rendering buffer implementations in ANGLE, including method declarations for setting storage, retrieving image data, and querying properties.

classes.name: RenderbufferImpl
classes.description: Abstract class for renderbuffer implementations, providing interface for storage management and image retrieval.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Sets the storage for the renderbuffer with specified internal format and dimensions.

methods.name: setStorageMultisample
methods.description: Sets multisample storage for the renderbuffer.

methods.name: setStorageEGLImageTarget
methods.description: Associates an EGL image as storage for the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns the format used for reading pixels from the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getColorReadType
methods.description: Returns the data type used for reading pixels from the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getRenderbufferImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image data from the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getMemorySize
methods.description: Returns the memory size of the renderbuffer, override if accurate info is available.
